description: Word-sized charts for React. 106 chart types, zero runtime dependencies, accessible by default, RSC-safe.
rules: Import each chart from its own subpath, not the package root: `import { Sparkline } from '@microcharts/react/sparkline'`.
The default export of every chart is static, hook-free, and RSC-safe. Import from `@microcharts/react/<chart>/interactive` only when the chart needs hover, focus, or keyboard interaction.
Import the stylesheet once at the app root: `import '@microcharts/react/styles.css'`. Charts render unstyled without it.
`data` is the only prop a chart needs. Every other prop is optional and has a correct default.
The same prop name means the same thing on every chart: `domain`, `color`, `title`, `summary`, `label`, `dots`, `format`, `positive`.
Annotations are children, not props. Import them from `@microcharts/react/annotations` and nest `<Threshold>`, `<TargetZone>`, `<Marker>`, or `<Callout>` inside a chart.
Every chart is `role="img"` with a generated natural-language summary as its accessible name. Pass `summary={false}` only for decorative charts, and pass a string to override the generated text.
Theme with the `--mc-*` CSS custom properties or the `defineTheme` helper from `@microcharts/react/theme`. Do not target internal class names.
A different data shape means a different component, not an option object. Check the chart catalog before reshaping data to fit a chart.
